A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the risk of cork off-odor production is higher when fungi are present in cork stoppers, and that the risk is higher when fungi and bacteria are present together.
the risk of off-odor formation in cork is mainly related to fungi, and the most important off-odor compound produced by these microorganisms is TCA.

the risk of off-odor production is higher in cork stoppers inoculated with fungi, and that some microorganisms are capable of producing unpleasant musty- or vegetative odorous compounds in cork stoppers.

the presence of TCA is not always the cause of off-odor in cork stoppers.
